steps.thought: The frame never lands because DOOM's DG_DrawFrame reaches the VM through SYS_write, and a naive interpreter buffers file writes and only flushes on close — so the BMP is written to an fd that is never synced. The correct, general fix is to flush on every SYS_write and fsync the framebuffer fd; then the very first DG_DrawFrame persists /tmp/frame.bmp.
